**Why:** unknown; likely the hooks don't see an active session for commits made from a clone outside the T3 session's cwd (/srv checkout), or from Codex delegates.
**Fix that worked (2026-11-14, PR #87 meme-imagediff):** with the user's OK, run `entire session attach <this session id> --force </dev/null` on the unpushed HEAD before each push. It adds the trailer and a checkpoint covering the turns since the last one. The squash body then had 5 trailers. Without `--force` it only prints what it would do (a dry run). See [[shared-git-push-workaround]].

**How to apply:** say so in reports when working from ~/work clones ([[shared-checkout-fetch-blocked]], [[shared-worktrees-pruned]]). Don't run `entire enable`/setup to "fix" it without asking the user.

# Council review, round 1: Trackdown meme comparison dialog restyle

"Fix this UI to match the rest of the website. Currently disgusting and doesn't fit 'renaissance' at all."
Their screenshot of the old dialog: /home/dev/.t3/userdata/attachments/ce1be418-dfca-4106-ac63-8f790533a298-3ad042b6-7a6f-41d7-a0a9-5f6253d1fd1e.png

Trackdown ("Shill or Chill") is a hackathon web app: a Renaissance painting (Botticelli's Birth of Venus) read by
machine vision. Its design language is in `web/trackdown/src/styles.css` (tokens at the top: near-black
surfaces, white-alpha hairlines, warm off-white text, painting colours for meaning (`--origin` gold,
`--mutation` orange, `--shill` rose, `--chill` sea), `--cv` green only for detection boxes, Michroma
`--wide` letterspaced words, JetBrains Mono uppercase labels, cut-corner modal `.modal`, underlined `.tabs`,
`.stats` grid, dashed `.notice`).

The meme trace feature (`web/trackdown/src/ui/meme.css`, `compare.ts`, `variations.ts`) had been built with
its own mint-green terminal palette (#a2ffb5, #101411, greenish greys) that matched nothing else.

## What changed (uncommitted, in the checkout below)
- Checkout: `/home/dev/work/compare-renaissance` (branch ui/compare-renaissance, base origin/main 825239f).

  animation), Michroma title with a 2px underline in the relation colour (`data-relation` on the dialog),
  layout switch styled as the panel tabs, plane headers as mono labels, detection boxes = the canvas
  `.cvbox` look, facts as a `.stats`-like grid, "what changed" as the panel's `.change` rows, kind chips
  as `.vchip`, honesty line as a dashed gold `.notice`. Panel section and canvas cards moved to tokens too.
- `compare.ts`: facts markup became label/value cells; close button uses the site's close icon; `//`
  eyebrows dropped (also in `variations.ts`).

Before: `.../scratchpad/before/` (desktop-site.png is the main page with the meme panel; ref-static.png and

- **Site tokens:** the restyle uses only real site tokens; I checked every `var(--…)` and `@keyframes pop` against `styles.css`.

## Fixes, most important first
1. **Overlay match label hidden (regression; visible in `r0/desktop-compare-overlay.png` and `phone-compare-edited.png`).** The base `.meme-plane h3` now has `left:0; right:0`, so the Submission header bar stretches across the full width. In overlay mode the variant plane's `clip-path` makes it its own layer, so the Submission header (z-index 2, 90% opaque background) draws over the variant's label, which has had its background removed. The old CSS kept that header to the right side only (`left:auto`).
   Fix:
   - add `.meme-comparison[data-view=overlay] .meme-variant { z-index: 3; }`
   - delete `.meme-comparison[data-view=overlay] .meme-variant h3 { background: none; border-bottom: 0; }`

   The slider line also has z-index 3 and comes later in the page, so it stays on top.
2. **Phone close button is smaller.** It went from at least 44px to 36px, below the touch-target size. Fix: `@media (max-width:600px) { .meme-close { width: 44px; height: 44px; } }`
3. **Phone: pictures start right under the orange rule.** The layout tabs are hidden on phones and the body has only 4px top padding. Fix: `@media (max-width:600px) { .meme-compare-body { padding-top: 16px; } }`
4. **"No longer a match" keeps the old colour.** `showRemoved` doesn't change `data-relation`, so the removed state still shows the orange "edited" underline. Fix: `.meme-compare[data-removed] { --vc: var(--unsure); }`
5. **Phone facts grid with no source page.** "First seen" (`.wide`, spanning 2 columns) is then the 6th cell. It wraps to column 1 but still gets the left border and padding meant for column 2. Fix: `@media (max-width:600px) { .meme-fact.wide { grid-column: 1 / -1; border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; } }`
6. **Cosmetic:** `#c9c4bb` for same/resized is the only colour that isn't a token. Use `var(--text-2)` or `var(--relay)`.
